subject: design/acquisition-trust-v1
statement: install.sh carries the release `manifest_sha256` and, after installing the CLI, records it with the system version at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/pyxis/release.env` — written only for the pinned version, whose manifest sha the script ships. `pyxis init` resolves the version and manifest sha256 in order: the `--system-version`/`--manifest-sha256` **flag**, else the `PYXIS_*` **env var**, else **release.env**; it refuses by name, listing all three sources, when none supply a pin.
